text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Aaand done! Another productive day
finished!
Now it's time to get changed,
take a bath, and
take a princess dive
into bed.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No, wait! I have to read that romance
manga I
borrowed from Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Um... I believe she said it was a story
with a prince
in it.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Let's see here... Oh, wow!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This prince has got style! He's using all
these
princely moves I've never seen
before!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One Sunday, I'm taking a stroll through
town
when...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh nooo! I'm late! I'M LAAATE!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaah! WATCH OUT!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I barely dodge Kawakami Princess as she
charges
past me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh? That's weird. This is different to how
I
imagined it in my head...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You were supposed to catch me in your
embrace,
and then we'd begin waltzing
while you asked,
"Are you all right, my
dear?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Well, to tell you the truth, last night, I
had an
unexpected culture shock!
choice_data_list_en: What on earth are you talking about...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I always imagined a prince to be exactly
like
Legendary Trainer from Princess
Fighter, but...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The prince I read about yesterday also
had the
strength to effortlessly carry a
princess in his
arms!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
So of course, it's only natural that a
prince should
be strong enough to lift a
truck or two, right?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
He also had the speed to always arrive in
time to
save the princess from danger! I
never knew
princes had leg strength on
par with Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems to be wildly misinterpreting
something
with this new information
she's learned about
princes.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'd love it so much if you'd show me your
princely
moves, Trainer! Please!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but princes can do lots of moves,
right?
Which would be best for you to
demonstrate?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hmm... In that case, um...
choice_data_list: ……体より心が試されるやつとかは？
choice_data_list_en: ...How about something that tests your spirit more than your body?
You know, something a bit unconventional...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I've got it! Trainer, as I walk by, I
want you to
pin me to the wall with an
assertive SLAM!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Right, it might be a little dangerous
to do it
here, so let's go elsewhere!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What part of this is supposed to be
dangerous?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Okay, here we go, Trainer! Show me
your best
princely Wall Buster!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's a passionate battle between the
prince
and the princess! The one who
pins the other
against the wall is the
victor!
choice_data_list: ウォ、ウォールバスター！？

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You attempt to corner me with all the
force you
can muster, and I'll evade you
with everything I've
got!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this! If you won't bring the fight
to me, I'll
bring it to you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though I end up terribly exhausted by
the end, I
somehow manage to survive
our wall-slamming
endeavors and return
home in one piece.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Unconventional? Hmm, what to choose...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I want to try that one where the
princess
takes the prince's hand, and
they flee from a
group of pursuers!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The prince is trapped in a dire situation

when—bam! The princess appears to
whisk him
away! With their trust in each
other, the prince
and princess flee to
safety!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now, take my hand! I'll reel you in like
I've gone
fishing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I get "fished up" by Kawakami
Princess
over and over until she is finally
satisfied with our
situational training.
